SELECT fiscal_period, MIN(period_start_date) s, MAX(period_end_date) e, MAX(fully_loaded) fl, MAX(weeks_in_period) w
FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND fiscal_period BETWEEN 8 AND 12 GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH wd AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, login_state, status, fulfilment_type, member_key AS order_member_key,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_period, wd.login_state,
       (f.member_key IS NOT NULL) AS line_has_member, (wd.order_member_key IS NOT NULL) AS order_has_member,
       COUNT(*) n_lines, COUNT(DISTINCT f.sales_line_id) n_distinct_lines, ROUND(SUM(f.net_amount),2) net
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN wd ON wd.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=wd.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test' AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY ALL ORDER BY 1,2,3,4

SELECT d.fiscal_week, MIN(f.sale_date) first_sale, MAX(f.sale_date) last_sale,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL) missing_member_lines,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.login_state='logged_in') logged_in_lines,
  COUNT(DISTINCT f.etl_loaded_at) FILTER (WHERE o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL) etl_ts_missing,
  MIN(f.etl_loaded_at) FILTER (WHERE o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL) min_etl,
  MAX(f.etl_loaded_at) FILTER (WHERE o.login_state='logged_in' AND f.member_key IS NULL) max_etl,
  COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE o.login_state='guest' AND f.member_key IS NOT NULL) guest_with_member
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN fact_web_order o ON o.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', o.dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE)
WHERE s.store_id=900 AND d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_week BETWEEN 30 AND 50
GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

WITH web_orders AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
),
web_lines AS (
  SELECT w.dispatch_date AS business_date, w.order_member_key IS NOT NULL AS is_member, f.net_amount AS gross_of_returns, f.net_amount AS net_after_returns
  FROM fact_sales_line f
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_orders w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
  UNION ALL
  SELECT r.return_date, w.order_member_key IS NOT NULL, 0, -r.refund_net
  FROM fact_return_line r
  JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=r.store_key
  JOIN fact_sales_line f ON f.sales_line_id=r.sales_line_id
  JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
  JOIN web_orders w ON w.web_order_id=f.receipt_id
  WHERE s.store_id=900 AND p.category<>'ZZ Test'
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
  ROUND(SUM(l.gross_of_returns),2) web_before_returns,
  ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN is_member THEN l.gross_of_returns ELSE 0 END),2) member_before_returns,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN is_member THEN l.gross_of_returns ELSE 0 END)/SUM(l.gross_of_returns),2) share_before_returns_pct,
  ROUND(SUM(l.net_after_returns),2) web_after_returns,
  ROUND(100.0*SUM(CASE WHEN is_member THEN l.net_after_returns ELSE 0 END)/SUM(l.net_after_returns),2) share_after_returns_pct
FROM web_lines l JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date=l.business_date
WHERE d.fiscal_year='FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1,2 ORDER BY 2

WITH web_orders AS (
  SELECT web_order_id, member_key AS order_member_key,
         CAST(timezone('Europe/Helsinki', dispatch_ts_utc AT TIME ZONE 'UTC') AS DATE) AS dispatch_date
  FROM fact_web_order
  WHERE status IN ('delivered','collected')
)
SELECT d.fiscal_year, d.fiscal_period,
       ROUND(100.0 * SUM(CASE WHEN w.order_member_key IS NOT NULL THEN f.net_amount ELSE 0 END) / SUM(f.net_amount), 1) AS member_share_of_web_sales_pct
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key = f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key = f.product_key
JOIN web_orders w ON w.web_order_id = f.receipt_id
JOIN dim_date d ON d.calendar_date = w.dispatch_date
WHERE s.store_id = 900 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND d.fiscal_year = 'FY2025/26' AND d.fiscal_period BETWEEN 9 AND 11
GROUP BY 1, 2
ORDER BY 2
